_template_notes.purpose: Frontend Route graph — Discovery Plugin #10 (v2.0 Gói C++). Parse Next.js App Router structure: page.tsx, layout.tsx, middleware.ts, loading.tsx, error.tsx, not-found.tsx. Build route hierarchy + dynamic segment detection + parent-child nesting. Source: Glob `apps/erp-web/app/**/*.{tsx,ts}`. Consumed by lanes CD25 (UX Flow Continuity) + CD38 (UI Implementation Coverage) qua graph_dependency.
populate: nodes[]: 1 entry per route file — {id, name, kind, route_path, module, file_path, is_dynamic, dynamic_params[], is_protected, fingerprint}
nodes[].route_path: URL path derived from file system (vd '/dashboard/customers/[id]' từ `app/dashboard/customers/[id]/page.tsx`)
nodes[].is_dynamic: true nếu route có `[param]` segment
nodes[].is_protected: true nếu route nằm trong `(protected)` route group HOẶC middleware redirect detected
edges[]: 1 entry per route hierarchy — {from_route, to_route, kind: 'child_of'|'wrapped_by'|'middleware_protects'}
metadata.source_method: 'glob_filesystem' (v1.0 dùng filesystem traversal — KHÔNG cần AST)
metadata.parser_version: '1.0' filesystem-based; v2.1 → AST parse cho metadata exports (generateMetadata)
skip_conditions: Project KHÔNG có apps/erp-web/app/ → SKIP, write empty graph với skipped:true (per CD25 graph_dependency optional, E137 WARN)
Project dùng Pages Router thay vì App Router → SKIP (v2.0 chỉ support App Router; Pages Router defer v2.1)
